Shell(C_RESET=$'\033[0m' C_DIM=$'\033[2m' status_color() { case "$1" in blocked) printf '\033[31m' ;; working) printf '\033[33m' ;; idle) printf '\033[32m' ;; done) printf '\033[34m' ;; *) printf '\033[90m' ;; esac } raw=$'workspace\tw2J\tidle\ttrack-a-arcade\t1p/1t\nagent\tw3J:p1\tworking\tcmd\tcmd · x' while IFS=$'\t' read -r type target status label detail; do [[ -z ${type:-} ]] && continue color="$(status_color "$status")" case "$type" in workspace) icon="$color◆$C_RESET" ;; agent) icon="$color●$C_RESET" ;; dir) icon="\033[36m▸$C_RESET" ;; esac printf '%s\t%s\t%s %s %s\n' "$type" "$target" "$icon" "$label" "$C_DIM$detail$C_RESET" done <<< "$raw")
